picks.editorial_note: A $334 million Schmidt Sciences grant to NCSA is one of the largest single investments in academic scientific computing this year, directly expanding national AI research capacity.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the Schmidt Science Computing Network establishes a new high-performance AI platform at NERSC, pairing major funding with a significant academic-national lab partnership.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment to fund 20 Turing AI Fellows represents a substantial national commitment to building UK AI research capacity across fields from physics to the humanities.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project applies agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations at the proton scale, a notable case of frontier AI techniques accelerating fundamental physics as part of DOE's Genesis Mission.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST pairs AI and robotics for automated coral reef monitoring, a cross-border academic collaboration with direct environmental application.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College spinout Cogitat by neurotech firm Indivi validates academic brain-foundation-model research with real commercial traction in clinical neurotechnology.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review spanning MIT CSAIL and 15+ institutions cataloguing 95 scenarios of AI-driven catastrophic risk is a significant contribution to the policy conversation on AI safety governance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's finding that a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to governments highlights a critical gap in AI hardware oversight with direct relevance to national security and export-control policy.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA's finding that AI materials models need far less training data than assumed could meaningfully lower the cost and barrier to AI-accelerated materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: The completion of DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals demonstrates autonomous systems and human-machine teaming for disaster response reaching a real competitive benchmark, a concrete step toward fielded government AI applications.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event
